description: Send a project idea to RegusciLabs to start discovery. Requires the person's explicit approval and contact details. Validate with dryRun:true first. Does not subscribe the person. Live submissions send a team notification and attempt CRM storage. Save an idempotencyKey before sending and reuse it with identical input for retries within 7 days; never retry an uncertain action with a new key.

budget.description: Budget status from the person, e.g. to be defined. Do not invent an amount.

challenge.description: The idea, the problem and what the person wants to test.

challengeType.description: The kind of idea: AI, software, hardware or an unusual experiment.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the person explicitly approves sending these details to RegusciLabs.

dryRun.description: Defaults to true: validate only, with no delivery or storage. Set false only for an approved live submission.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for one approved live action. Reuse it with identical input for retries for 7 days; use a new key for a different intended action. Without a key, automatic retry is unsafe.

name: submit_inquiry
